say: Its training data is Hack Rep: a hundred thousand hackathon repositories, filtered down to fifty-six thousand projects, each cut into seven phases.
phonemes: ɪts tɹˈeɪnɪŋ dˈeɪɾə ɪz hˈæk ɹˈɛp: ɐ hˈʌndɹɪd θˈaʊzənd hˈækəθˌɑːn ɹᵻpˈɑːzɪtˌɔːɹiz, fˈɪltɚd dˌaʊn tə fˈɪftisˈɪks θˈaʊzənd pɹˈɑːdʒɛkts, ˈiːtʃ kˈʌt ˌɪntʊ sˈɛvən fˈeɪzᵻz.
